'''Balic Cormac''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the military forces of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Balic and his troops captured a [[House of Thul|House Thul]] prisoner named [[Markus Andarius Thul|Markus Thul]] who was leading a group of Imperial commandos to sneak inside the castle Organa. He was ordered to place the prisoner inside the Organa's detention center on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and find out information that he was hiding. Eventually, Balic encountered the new Havoc squad [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|lieutenant]] who was sent by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]] to search for [[Bex Kolos|Gearbox]], who was one of the traitors from [[Havoc Squad]]. Balic was able to provide everything and set the security doors to grant access for the lieutenant to interrogate the prisoner.

After Markus provided the intel and begging the Havoc lieutenant to save his family, Balic didn't believe that Markus was telling the truth. He was seen with [[Pallos Thessius Organa|Pallos Organa]] after the Havoc lieutenant was able to stop an Imperial missile that Gearbox launched to destroy Castle Organa.
